annotations.title: Read how a sheet is meant to be used

description: How the track's sheet is meant to be used, in its author's words: the lines of its Start here tab (startHere), the lines its author headed For assistants (forAssistants: what you should do, or never do, in this sheet), what it recommends setting up first (recommended: what, steps and https links; offer these when setting up a copy, with turn_on_ready_hack when what names a ready-made hack), its tabs, its data tab and its Settings (each setting with its value). TrackerHacker's guide says how TrackerHacker works; this says how one sheet works: which list to add to for what, which answers it expects, which columns its formulas fill. Read it before working in a sheet's own tabs (add_to_list, set_card_value, answering its questions, add_rows beyond a plain payment or entry), and follow its For assistants lines.
name: get_sheet_guide
